records.title: Purchase requisition approval not triggered for new document type

records.title: Root cause for recurring ZFI_DAILY_UPLOAD cancellations
records.problem_statement: Problem ticket raised after five restarts in two months.
records.error_message: Lock on table ZFI_UPL
records.investigation_notes: Compared job logs. Cancellations always occur between 02:00 and 02:20. Another job ZIF_BANK_IN started 02:00 after a schedule change and holds a lock on the same custom table.
records.resolution: Resequenced jobs with predecessor dependency so ZFI_DAILY_UPLOAD starts after ZIF_BANK_IN. Monitored for 3 weeks with no recurrence.
records.root_cause: Overlapping job schedule creating a table lock
